selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What had kept the Qur’an’s holy rule shining through many centuries?
questions.answer: Its special qualities and strong features had kept it shining.

questions.question: For about how long does the passage say the Qur’an has continued to shine over time?
questions.answer: For about thirteen hundred years.

questions.question: What two places are described as being lit up by the Qur’an’s greatness?
questions.answer: The passing centuries and the earth.

questions.question: What is the smallest reward mentioned for one letter of the Qur’an?
questions.answer: At least ten rewards.

questions.question: Besides rewards, what other two good results are mentioned for each letter?
questions.answer: Merits and lasting fruits.

questions.question: Do all letters always have only ten rewards, or can some have more?
questions.answer: Some can have much more.

questions.question: Which parts of the Qur’an are said to bring a hundred or a thousand fruits?
questions.answer: The letters in some verses and surahs.

questions.question: What happens to the value of each letter during blessed times?
questions.answer: It rises from ten to hundreds.

questions.question: How many kinds of proof are mentioned before saying the Qur’an has this high rank?
questions.answer: Six kinds are mentioned.

questions.question: What do these six kinds show about the Qur’an’s rule?
questions.answer: They show its rule is lofty, bright, holy, and strong.

questions.question: What word in the passage shows that the Qur’an’s influence did not stop after a short time?
questions.answer: It says the influence continued.

questions.question: If one letter gives at least ten rewards, what does that suggest about reciting many letters?
questions.answer: Reciting many letters can bring many rewards.

questions.question: What comparison can you make between normal times and blessed times in this passage?
questions.answer: In blessed times, the reward becomes much greater than usual.

questions.question: Why might the passage mention single letters instead of only whole chapters?
questions.answer: To show that even the smallest part of the Qur’an is precious.

questions.question: What did the traveler do right after understanding these truths?
questions.answer: He turned inward and spoke to his heart.

questions.question: Who received this understanding before the final line of the passage?
questions.answer: The traveler through the world received it.

questions.question: According to the passage, what comes from the letters of the Qur’an?
questions.answer: Rewards, merits, and eternal fruits come from them.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the honor of the Qur’an’s letters?
questions.answer: They have a special and holy honor.

questions.question: Is the reward connected only to big sections of the Qur’an, or also to each letter?
questions.answer: It is connected even to each letter.

questions.question: How does the passage describe the Qur’an’s rule using words about power and holiness?
questions.answer: It describes it as exalted, bright, sacred, and mighty.

questions.question: What shows that the Qur’an’s message reaches across time?
questions.answer: It has kept shining through many centuries.

questions.question: What shows that the Qur’an’s message reaches across the world?
questions.answer: It has lit up the face of the earth.

questions.question: What does the traveler’s speaking to his heart tell us about his response?
questions.answer: He was taking the lesson seriously and personally.

questions.question: What can we understand about the Qur’an from the fact that even its letters are rewarded?
questions.answer: The Qur’an is deeply honored and full of blessing.
